class.name: HEGoGraph3D
class.brief_description: A 3D graph of points and connections: authored as a [HEGoNode3D] input, or built by a cook's graph output (see [HEGoGraphOutput]).
class.description:
Add a [HEGoGraphAttributes] child to declare the attributes each point and connection can carry; a graph built by a cook gets one listing what the HDA sent. Positions are stored in local space. Connections are undirected unique pairs; a point with three or more connections is an intersection. Any graph can feed another cook's input.
Large graphs (tens of thousands of points) draw only their connection lines while they are not being edited; point markers appear when the graph is selected, up to [member marker_limit].

method.name: connection_count
method.description: Number of connections, i.e. half of [member connections].

method.name: get_connection
method.description: The two point indices of connection [param index], smaller first.

method.name: add_point
method.description: Appends a point at [param position] and returns its index.

method.name: set_point_position
method.description: Moves point [param index] to [param position].

method.name: set_point_position_live
method.description: Sets a point during a live gizmo drag without emitting [signal graph_changed].

method.name: snapped_to_surface
method.description: [param position] (graph local) with its height replaced by the surface under it plus [member surface_offset]. Unchanged where there is no surface.

method.name: snap_all_to_surface
method.description: Moves every point onto the surface under it ([member surface_provider], else physics) plus [member surface_offset]. Returns the number of points that moved.

method.name: request_snap_all
method.description: What the "Snap all points to surface" button calls: lets an editor do it as an undoable action through [signal snap_all_requested], else snaps directly.

method.name: get_path_mesh
method.description: The path visualisation mesh (fill and outline surfaces, in local space), rebuilt only when the graph or a visualisation property changed since the last call. Null when [member path_mode] is off. The editor gizmo draws it.

method.name: remove_points
method.description: Deletes the given point indices and any connection that used them. Remaining connection indices are remapped.

method.name: add_connection
method.description: Adds an undirected connection between [param a] and [param b]. Returns the new connection index, or [code]-1[/code] if the pair is invalid or already present.

method.name: has_connection
method.description: Whether an undirected connection between [param a] and [param b] already exists.

method.name: remove_connections
method.description: Deletes the given connection indices. Points are left in place.

method.name: split_connection
method.description: Inserts a point at [param position] on connection [param conn_index], replacing that connection with two that inherit its attributes. Returns the new point index, or [code]-1[/code] if the connection does not exist.

method.name: set_point_attrib_on
method.description: Sets attribute [param name] on each of [param indices] to [param value].

method.name: set_connection_attrib_on
method.description: Sets attribute [param name] on each of [param indices] to [param value].

method.name: sync_schema
method.description: Rebuilds stored attribute arrays from [HEGoGraphAttributes] children: adds missing keys at their defaults, drops keys that are no longer defined, and resizes to the current point and connection counts.

method.name: collect_schema
method.description: Attribute definitions from every [HEGoGraphAttributes] child, in tree order. Reserved and duplicate names are skipped with a warning.

method.name: is_reserved_name
method.description: Whether [param name] is reserved for Houdini or HEGo metadata.

method.name: capture_state
method.description: A copy of the topology and attribute arrays, for undo.

method.name: apply_state
method.description: Restores a state produced by [method capture_state].

members.member: Point positions, in this node's local space.
Connection endpoints as index pairs [code][a0, b0, a1, b1, ...][/code]. Each pair is stored with the smaller index first.
Per-point attribute values, keyed by name. Each value is a packed array the same length as [member points].
Per-connection attribute values, keyed by name. Each value is a packed array the same length as [method connection_count].

Draws the graph as a path: a translucent ribbon or tube along every connection whose width comes from an attribute, with an outline. It is part of the graph's editor gizmo, so it only exists in the editor and View > Gizmos hides it.

Name of the attribute that gives the path width in metres. A connection attribute of that name wins over a point attribute, which is interpolated between the ends of a connection. Missing or zero values use [member path_default_width].
Width in metres where [member path_width_attribute] gives none.
Ribbon or tube. A tube uses the width as its diameter.
Colour and opacity of the ribbon or tube.
Draws the boundary: both ribbon edges and the end caps, or the tube's silhouette lines and end rings.
Colour of the outline.

Lays the path on the surface between points, and orients the ribbon to its normal, using the [member surface_provider] or physics colliders. Without a surface the path runs straight between points and the ribbon faces up.
Distance in metres between samples when draping.
Height of the path above the surface along its normal, to avoid z-fighting.
Segments around a tube.
Draws the connection lines while the graph is not selected. Point markers only appear while it is selected.

While the graph is selected, every point gets a marker up to this many points; larger graphs mark only the selected and hovered points, so a cooked graph with tens of thousands of points stays responsive.

Optional node that gives the ground height, for snapping and for the path visualisation. It needs [code]sample_height(Vector2) -> float[/code], taking a local x/z position and returning the local height, and may have [code]contains_position(Vector2) -> bool[/code]. Without one, a physics ray from above is used. HEGo does not depend on any terrain addon.
Puts every point added or moved in the editor on the surface.
Height above the surface in metres that snapped points get.
Moves every point onto the surface now, as one undoable step.
Increments whenever the graph changes, so editor previews can cache what they build.

signal.name: graph_changed
signal.description: The graph's topology or attribute values changed.

signal.name: snap_all_requested
signal.description: Emitted by [method request_snap_all] when an editor wants to apply the snap as an undoable action. Without a listener the snap is applied directly.

constants.constant: Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
Names that already mean something on Houdini input geometry.
Prefix reserved for HEGo's own metadata attributes.
A flat translucent band lying on the surface.
A cylinder per connection with a sphere at each point.
